symptom: The v43 handoff archive replay fails with FileNotFoundError for boatpon-v40-sdk-atomic-write-test-double.ts after patch provenance and source reconstruction; the replay script refers to a file omitted from the ZIP.
lesson: A green replay in a populated working directory does not prove that a distributed archive is independently reproducible. Required local test-double dependencies must be packaged and validated before reconstruction or TypeScript checks.
guardrail: Every offline handoff must be tested from a freshly extracted archive with a manifest of required files and SHA-256 digests. Fail before worktree creation on missing or modified dependencies; include negative missing-file and tamper controls. Local SDK test doubles never establish canonical SDK integration.
